profile.name: Glassman FR系列高压直流电源
profile.name_en: Glassman FR Series high-voltage DC power supply
profile.description: 这是一款单路输出的高压直流电源，可远程设定输出电压和电流、开关高压输出，并读取实际输出电压、电流、恒压/恒流工作模式及故障状态。适用于需要稳定高压偏置、电源激励或高压测试的实验室装置与实验平台。
profile.description_en: This is a single-output high-voltage DC power supply that can be remotely controlled to set output voltage and current, enable or disable the high-voltage output, and read back measured voltage, current, operating mode, and fault status. It is used in laboratory setups that require stable high-voltage biasing, powering, or high-voltage test conditions.
